## 12. BI & ANALYTICS

### 12.1 Search ANPR Passing Records
```
POST /api/hccgw/bi/v1/anpr/passing/record/search
```

Search ANPR (license plate recognition) records.
**Request:**

**Headers:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Token | Yes | String | Token. The maximum length is 64. |

**Body Parameters:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| allCamera | Yes | Boolean | Whether to search records of all cameras (logical resources). |
| cameraIdList | No | String[] | Camera ID (logical resource ID). If allCamera = true, this field does not need to be configured. |
| timeType | Yes | Integer | 0 (time of client), 1 (time of local device). |
| startTime | Yes | String | Start time in ISO 8601 format, which is represented by "yyyy-MMddTHH: mm:ss +current time zone", e.g., "2024-08- 21T00:00:00+08:00". Refer to the datasheet for the supported search time range. |
| endTime | Yes | String | End time in ISO 8601 format, which is represented by "yyyy-MMddTHH: mm:ss +current time zone", e.g., "2024-08- 21T00:00:00+08:00". Refer to the datasheet for the supported search time range. |
| licensePlate | No | String | License plate number. 0 to 512 characters are allowed. |
| personName | No | String | Vehicle owner name. 0 to 512 characters are allowed. |
| vehicleModel | No | Integer[] | Vehicle type: 1-bus, 2-truck, 3-sedan, 4- minivan, 5-small-sized truck, 6-two- wheeler, 7-tricycle, 8-medium-sized coach, 9-motor vehicle, 10-non-motor vehicle, 11-suv/mpv, 12-small-sized vehicle, 13-mini sedan, 14-pickup truck, 15-container truck, 16-micro truck, 17- dump truck, 18-crane, 19-oil tank truck, 20-concrete mixer, 21-flatbed tow truck, 22-two-box vehicle, 23-three-box vehicle, 24-sport sedan, 25-small-sized coach, 26- large-sized coach, 27-pedestrian, 28-light truck, 29-medium and heavy truck, 30- school bus, 31-ambulance, 32-garbage truck, 33-cleaning vehicle, 34-operation vehicle. |
| brand | No | Integer[] | Vehicle brand. Refer to Vehicle Brand . |
| color | No | Integer | Vehicle color: 1-white, 2-silver, 3-gray, 4- deep gray, 5-black, 6-red, 7-blue, 8- deepBlue, 9-yellow, 10-green, 11-brown, 12-pink, 13-purple, 14-cyan, 15-orange. |
| speedRangeStart | No | Integer | Minimum vehicle speed (unit: km/h). It can be empty, value range: (0,1000). |
| speedRangeEnd | No | Integer | Maximum vehicle speed (unit: km/h). It can be empty, value range: (0,1000). |
| country | No | Integer | Country/region. Refer to for details. |
| direction | No | Integer | Direction: -1 (unknown), 0 (reverse), 1 (forward). |
| pageSize | No | Integer | Number of records on each page. It can be empty, and the default value is 20 when it is empty. |
| searchAfter | No | Object[] | Pagination parameter. Directly use nextSearchAfter returned in response message. If this field is absent, it defaults to the first page. |



**Request Example:**

```json
{
    "allCamera": false,
    "timeType": 0,
    "startTime": "2024-08-21T00:00:00+08:00",
    "endTime": "2024-10-21T00:00:00+08:00",
    "licensePlate": "licensePlate_f1c2d883c2cd",
    "personName": "personName_8ca9a70c3752",
    "nameListId": "nameListId_4f56745564be",
    "vehileModel": [
                        0
                    ],
    "brand": [
                  0
              ],
    "color": 0,
    "speedRangeStart": 0,
    "speedRangeEnd": 0,
    "country": 0,
    "direction": 0,
    "pageSize": 0,
    "searchAfter": [
                        {

                        }
                    ]
}
```
**Response:** `passingRecordList[]` (each: `plateNo`, `plateColor`, `speed`, `roadDirection`, `captureTime`, `cameraId`)

### 12.3 Get People Flow Report
```
POST /api/hccgw/bi/v1/store/report/peopleflow
```

Get customer traffic data.
**Request:**

**Headers:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Token | Yes | String | Token. The maximum length is 64. |

**Body Parameters:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| startTime | Yes | String | Start time. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. |
| endTime | Yes | String | End time. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. |
| statisticType | Yes | Integer | Statistical type: 1-by hour, 2-by day. |
| resourceType | Yes | Integer | Resource type: 0-camera, 1-entrance/exit, 2-store. |

```json
                     ],
    "statisticType": 0,
    "resourceType": 0,
    "timeType": 0
}
```
**Response:** `statisticType`, `storeDatas[]` → `cameraId`/`groupId`/`storeAreaId`, `countingDatas[]` (each: `startTime`, `endTime`, `enterCount`, `exitCount`, `passCount`, `updateTime`)

## 13. WEBHOOK

### 13.1 Query Webhook Config
```
POST /api/hccgw/webhook/v1/config/query
```


**Headers:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Token | Yes | String | Token. The maximum length is 64. |
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Data format. Only "application/json" is supported. |

Get webhook push configuration.
**Response:** `callbackUrl`, `retryTimes`, `retryDelay`

### 13.2 Save Webhook Config
```
POST /api/hccgw/webhook/v1/config/save
```

Save webhook push configuration.
**Notes:**
- Only ONE webhook config per account
- `callbackUrl` must use HTTPS
- After retry limit reached, messages persisted for 1 month

**Request:**

**Headers:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Token | Yes | String | Token. The maximum length is 64. |
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Data format. Only "application/json" is supported. |

**Body Parameters:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| callbackUrl | Yes | String | HTTPS URL, max 256 chars, supports GET+POST |
| retryTimes | No | Integer | -1=unlimited(2hrs), 0-5. Default: 3 |
| retryDelay | No | Long | Retry interval in ms |
| signSecret | No | String | Signature secret, 8-32 chars (letters+digits). Default: SK |

**Example:**
```json
{
    "callbackUrl": "https://xxx.com",
    "retryTimes": 3,
    "retryDelay": 1000,
    "signSecret": "xxxx"
}
```


**Request Example:**

```json
{
    "callbackUrl": "https://xxx.com",
    "retryTimes": 3,
    "retryDelay": 1000,
    "signSecret": "xxxx"
}
```
**Response:** `{"errorCode":"0"}`

### 13.3 Delete Webhook Config
```
POST /api/hccgw/webhook/v1/config/delete
```


**Headers:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Token | Yes | String | Token. The maximum length is 64. |
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Data format. Only "application/json" is supported. |


Delete webhook configuration.
**Response:** `{"errorCode":"0"}`

## 14. ACCESS LEVEL MANAGEMENT

### 14.1 Get Schedule Template List
```
POST /api/hccgw/acspm/v1/template/list
```

Get access schedule templates.
**Request:**

**Headers:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Token | Yes | String | Token. The maximum length is 64. |
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Data format. Only "application/json" is supported. |
| X-TenantId | Yes | String | Tenant ID, up to 64 characters are allowed. |
| X-UserId | Yes | String | User ID, up to 64 characters are allowed. |

**Body Parameters:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| pageIndex | No | Integer | Page number, default value: 1. |
| pageSize | No | Integer | Number of records on each page. It defaults to return all results when the field is empty or the input is invalid. |


**Request Example:**

```json
{
    "pageIndex": 1,
    "pageSize": 20
}
```
**Response:** `templateResponse.{pageIndex, pageSize, totalNum, templateList[]}`
Each template: `id`, `name`, `remark`, `weekSchedule.{timeSettingList[]}`, `holidayScheduleList[]`
- `timeSettingList`: `dayIndex` (0=Sun, 1-6=Mon-Sat), `timeSpanList[]` (`beginTime`, `endTime`)

### 14.2 Add Access Level
```
POST /api/hccgw/acspm/v1/access/level/add
```

Create access level.
**Request:**

**Headers:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Token | Yes | String | Token. The maximum length is 64. |
| Content-Type | Yes | String | Data format. Only "application/json" is supported. |

**Body Parameters:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| accessLevel | Yes | Object | Access level information. |
| accessLevel.timeSchedule.type | No | String | Schedule type, which consists of up to 64 characters. |

**accessLevel fields:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| name | Yes | String | Access level name, up to 64 characters. |
| remark | No | String | Remark information, up to 128 characters. |
| levelId | Yes | String | Access level ID. |
| levelName | Yes | String | Access level name. |
| levelType | Yes | Integer | Access level type. |
| validType | Yes | Integer | Valid type. |
| startDate | Yes | String | Start time of effective period. |
| endDate | Yes | String | End time of effective period. |
| repeatType | Yes | Integer | Repeat type. |
| timePeriod | Yes | TimePeriod[] | Time period list. |

**timePeriod fields:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| startTime | Yes | String | Start time. |
| endTime | Yes | String | End time. |
| weekDays | Yes | Integer[] | Week days. |





**Request Example:**

```json
{
    "accessLevel":  {
                        "name":  "access_level_001",
                        "remark":  "access_level_001",
                        "timeSchedule":  {
                                             "id":  "area_001"
                                         },
                        "associateResList":  [
                                                 {
                                                     "id":  "res_001"
                                                 },
                                                 {
                                                     "id":  "res_002"
                                                 }
                                             ]
                    }
}
```
**Response:** `accessLevel.{id, name, remark, areaInfo, timeSchedule, associateResList}`

### 14.9 Assign Access Level to Person

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |

| personId | Yes | String | Person ID. |
| firstName | Yes | String | Person's first name. |
| lastName | Yes | String | Person's last name. |
| phone | Yes | String | Phone No. |
| email | Yes | String | Email. |
| isExpired | Yes | String | Status: 0 (normal), 1 (expired). |
| photoUrl | Yes | String | URL of the face picture to be applied to the device. |
| headPicUrl | Yes | String | URL of the profile photo. |
| fullPath | No | String | Person group path. |
| startDate | Yes | String | Validity period start date, ISO time format. |
| endDate | Yes | String | Validity period end date, ISO time format. Year no more than 2037. |
| personId | No | String | Person ID, which contains 1 to 18 digits. |
| accessLevelIdList | No | String[] | Access level list. Each access level ID should contain 1 to 18 digits. |



**Request Example:**

```json
{
    "personList":  [
                       {
                           "personId":  "aaaa",
                           "accessLevelIdList":  [
                                                     "222",
                                                     "333"
                                                 ]
                       }
                   ]
}
```
**Response:** `accessLevelFailedList[]` (failed assignments)

### 14.10 Remove Access Level from Person
```
POST /api/hccgw/acspm/v1/accesslevel/person/delete
```

**Request:**

**Headers:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| Token | Yes | String | Token. The maximum length is 64. |

**Body Parameters:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| personList | Yes | Person | List corresponding to person and access level. |

**personList fields:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| personId | Yes | String | Person ID. |
| firstName | Yes | String | Person's first name. |
| lastName | Yes | String | Person's last name. |
| phone | Yes | String | Phone No. |
| email | Yes | String | Email. |
| isExpired | Yes | String | Status: 0 (normal), 1 (expired). |
| photoUrl | Yes | String | URL of the face picture to be applied to the device. |
| headPicUrl | Yes | String | URL of the profile photo. |
| fullPath | No | String | Person group path. |
| startDate | Yes | String | Validity period start date, ISO time format, e.g.: 2022-10- 21T11:08:23+08:00 |
| endDate | Yes | String | Validity period end date, ISO time format, e.g.: 2023-10- 21T11:08:23+08:00. The year should be no more than 2037. |
| personId | No | String | Person ID, 1-18 digits. |
| accessLevelIdList | No | String[] | Access level list. Each access level ID should contain 1-18 digits. |
| deleteAll | No | boolean | Whether to delete all. |




**Request Example:**

```json
{
    "personList":  [
                       {
                           "personId":  "aaaa",
                           "deleteAll":  false,
                           "accessLevelIdList":  [
                                                     "222",
                                                     "333"
                                                 ]
                       }
                   ]
}
```

**Body Parameters:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|

**personList fields:**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|

| firstName | Yes | String | Person's first name. |
| lastName | Yes | String | Person's last name. |
| phone | Yes | String | Phone No. |
| email | Yes | String | Email. |
| isExpired | Yes | String | Status: 0 (normal), 1 (expired). |

| headPicUrl | Yes | String | URL of the profile photo. |
| fullPath | No | String | Person group path. |
| firstName | No | String | First name. |
| lastName | No | String | Last name. |
| personCode | No | String | Employee No. |
| phoneNum | No | String | Phone number. |

| lastName | Yes | String | Last name, no more than 255 characters. First name and last name should be no more than 255 characters. |

| accessLevelIdList | No | String[] | Person full access level list. Back-end check adding and deleting according to history data. Access level ID should contain 1-18 digits. |

Modify person's access level assignment.

## 15. ISAPI PROTOCOL TRANSMISSION

### 15.1 ISAPI Proxy Pass
```
POST /api/hccgw/proxy/v1/isapi/proxypass
```

Transparently forward ISAPI protocol requests.
**Request:**
| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|-----------|----------|------|-------------|
| method | Yes | String | GET, POST, PUT, DELETE |
| url | Yes | String | ISAPI path, e.g., /ISAPI/PTZCtrl/channels/2/presets |
| id | Yes | String | Device ID (request tracking). Also accepts `deviceSerial` as alias. |
| contentType | Yes | String | application/xml, application/json, application/x-www-form-urlencoded |
| body | No | String | Request body (for POST/PUT) |

**Examples:**
```json
{
    "method": "GET",
    "url": "/ISAPI/PTZCtrl/channels/2/presets/1",
    "id": "85cff214670c4bc69a8d7436fb93576c",
    "contentType": "application/xml",
    "body": ""
}
```
**Example 2 (POST with deviceSerial):**
```json
{"method":"POST","url":"/ISAPI/PTZCtrl/channels/2/presets","deviceSerial":"85cff214670c4bc69a8d7436fb93576c","contentType":"application/xml","body":"<PTZData><PanTiltValue><Pan>100</Pan><Tilt>100</Tilt></PanTiltValue></PTZData>"}
```
**Example 3 (PUT with deviceSerial):**
```json
{
    "method": "PUT",
    "url": "/ISAPI/PTZCtrl/channels/1/auxcontrols/1",
    "deviceSerial": "85cff214670c4bc69a8d7436fb93576c",
    "contentType": "application/xml",
    "body": "\u003cPTZAux\u003e\u003ctype\u003eWIPER\u003c/type\u003e\u003cstatus\u003eon\u003c/status\u003e\u003c/PTZAux\u003e"
}
```

**Response:** `errorCode`, `message`, `data` (XML/JSON response from device)
**Request Example:**

```json
{
    "method": "GET",
    "url": "/ISAPI/PTZCtrl/channels/2/presets/1",
    "id": "85cff214670c4bc69a8d7436fb93576c",
    "contentType": "application/xml",
    "body": ""
}
```

---

## 16. TYPICAL APPLICATIONS

This chapter describes common integration workflows that combine multiple APIs.

### 16.1 Manage Resources

**Physical resources** (devices, cameras, doors, alarm inputs/outputs) and **logical resources** (areas) are managed separately.

- Physical resources: get device info via `POST /api/hccgw/resource/v1/devices/get`, operate individual devices
- Logical resources: get area tree via `POST /api/hccgw/resource/v1/areas/get`, cameras are logical resources added to areas

Key operations:
- Add device -> Add area -> Add resource to area -> List cameras/doors/alarms in area
- Delete resources by ID: `POST /api/hccgw/resource/v1/areas/resources/delete`

---

### 16.2 Subscribe to and Get Alarms

Recommended workflow:
1. Subscribe to alarm events: `POST /api/hccgw/alarm/v1/mq/subscribe`
2. Poll for alarm messages: `POST /api/hccgw/alarm/v1/mq/messages` (recommended interval: 500ms)

**Important notes:**
- Alarm subscription is auto-cancelled if no messages are pulled within 2 days
- Duplicate alarms are uploaded with attachments (pictures/videos)
- Polling interval recommended: 500ms

---

### 16.3 Configure Alarm Rules

1. Subscribe to alarms (see 16.2)
2. Create alarm rule: `POST /api/hccgw/alarm/v1/rule/add`
3. List rules: `POST /api/hccgw/alarm/v1/rule/list`
4. Update/delete rules as needed

---

### 16.4 Subscribe to and Get Raw Messages (V2)

For real-time event subscription via MQTT:
1. Subscribe: `POST /api/hccgw/combine/v1/mq/subscribe`
2. Pull messages: `POST /api/hccgw/combine/v1/mq/messages` (recommended interval: 500ms)

**Important:** Message subscription auto-cancelled if no messages received within 2 days.
Complete received messages: `POST /api/hccgw/combine/v1/mq/messages/complete`

---

### 16.5 Start Live View / Playback Without Plug-in

1. Get stream token: `POST /api/hccgw/platform/v1/streamtoken/get`
2. Get live address: `POST /api/hccgw/video/v1/liveaddress/get`
3. Get playback address: `POST /api/hccgw/video/v1/playbackaddress/get`
4. Use JSSDK for no-plugin playback

**Note:** RTMP/HLS playback NOT supported in India or Russia. Only RTSP is universally supported.

---

### 16.6 Video Intercom Events

Complete workflow:
1. Get token
2. Subscribe to intercom events (Msg140001): `POST /api/hccgw/rawmsg/v1/mq/subscribe`
3. When device calls, receive event message via webhook/polling
4. Get intercom messages: `POST /api/hccgw/rawmsg/v1/mq/messages`
5. Use JSSDK for live view and intercom
6. Respond to call: `POST /api/hccgw/devcall/v1/call/receive`
7. Remote door control: `POST /api/hccgw/acs/v1/remote/control`

---

### 16.7 Manage On-Board Monitoring

1. Add on-board device: `POST /api/hccgw/resource/v1/devices/add`
   - Link device with existing vehicle OR add new vehicle to platform
   - Device and vehicle must be in the same area
   - All logical resources of on-board devices are imported to the vehicle's area
2. Upload vehicle picture: `POST /api/hccgw/resource/v1/picture/uploadparam/get`
   - A vehicle can only be linked with one picture
3. Vehicle area is auto-created when adding vehicles (vehicle and area share same ID)
4. Delete vehicle -> area is also auto-deleted: `POST /api/hccgw/resource/v1/areas/resources/delete`

**Free package limit:** 10 vehicles, 8 camera channels.

---

### 16.8 Add Person

Complete workflow:
1. Get token
2. Get department/group list: `POST /api/hccgw/person/v1/groups/search`
3. Add person: `POST /api/hccgw/person/v1/persons/add`
4. (Optional) Update profile: `POST /api/hccgw/person/v1/persons/photo`
5. (Optional) Update PIN: `POST /api/hccgw/person/v1/persons/updatepincode`
6. (Optional) Collect fingerprint: `POST /api/hccgw/person/v1/persons/fingercollect`
7. (Optional) Collect card: `POST /api/hccgw/person/v1/persons/cardcollect`

**Quick add alternative:** `POST /api/hccgw/person/v1/persons/quick/add` - single API to add person + face picture + PIN code to device.

---

### 16.9 Apply Access Level to Person

1. Add access groups on platform
2. Get token
3. Get access level list: `POST /api/hccgw/acspm/v1/accesslevel/list`
4. Get person list: `POST /api/hccgw/person/v1/persons/list`
5. Assign access level by person: `POST /api/hccgw/acspm/v1/accesslevel/person/add`
6. Remove access level: `POST /api/hccgw/acspm/v1/accesslevel/person/delete`
7. Modify access level: `POST /api/hccgw/acspm/v1/accesslevel/person/modify`
8. Check applying info: `POST /api/hccgw/acspm/v1/maintain/overview/person/{id}/elementdetail`

After linking person with access group, updates to person info and credential info (face, card, fingerprint) sync automatically to devices in the group.

---

### 16.10 Update Fingerprint / Card Information

1. Get token
2. Collect fingerprint: `POST /api/hccgw/person/v1/persons/fingercollect`
   - Fingerprint information MUST be collected from device
3. Collect card: `POST /api/hccgw/person/v1/persons/cardcollect`
   - Cards without visible card number: must collect from device
   - Cards with visible card number: no need to collect from device
4. Update fingerprints: `POST /api/hccgw/person/v1/persons/updatefingers`
5. Update cards: `POST /api/hccgw/person/v1/persons/updatecards`

---

### 16.11 Add Temporary Pass (Visitor)

1. Get token
2. Get access level list: `POST /api/hccgw/acspm/v1/accesslevel/list`
3. Add temporary pass: `POST /api/hccgw/vims/v1/tempauth/add`
4. Use returned password and QR code for verification on linked device

**QR code types:**
- **Dynamic QR code:** Valid 60 seconds from obtainment. Call `POST /api/hccgw/vims/v1/tempauth/get` every 60s to refresh. Once a new dynamic QR code is used, the previous one becomes invalid.
- **Static QR code:** Valid for the entire temporary pass period.
- Platform can be configured to return dynamic or static QR code.

---

### 16.12 Add Resident (Intercom)

1. Get token
2. (Optional) Get room list: `POST /api/hccgw/vims/v1/room/search`
   - Room info can only be added via HCC/HCT platform
3. (Optional) Get access level list: `POST /api/hccgw/acspm/v1/accesslevel/list`
   - If building has device, resident auto-assigned building's access level
4. Add resident: `POST /api/hccgw/vims/v1/person/add`
5. Add credentials (face/fingerprint/card/PIN) - same as Add Person workflow

---

### 16.13 Update Resident

1. Get token
2. (Optional) Get room list
3. (Optional) Get access level list
4. Get resident info: `POST /api/hccgw/vims/v1/person/search`
5. Update resident: `POST /api/hccgw/vims/v1/person/update`
   - If resident owns 2 rooms, enter both room info; otherwise the left room is deleted by default
   - Can also use `POST /api/hccgw/person/v1/persons/update` for basic info only
6. Add credentials - same as Add Person workflow

---

### 16.14 Search Attendance Data

1. Get token
2. (Optional) Search card swipe records: `POST /api/hccgw/acs/v1/event/certificaterecords/search`
   - Check if a specific person performed attendance on a specific day on a specific device
3. Search attendance results: `POST /api/hccgw/attendance/v1/report/totaltimecard/list`
   - Get attendance result for a specific person on a specific day
   - Includes attendance duration and status

---

### 16.15 Webhook Message Push

**Prerequisite:** Open API platform account required.

Two message modes (choose one):
- **Polling** - Active message retrieval (original method)
- **Webhook** - Push-based message delivery

**Important:** After Webhook configuration, polling may no longer acquire messages. Contact technical support to switch from polling to Webhook if needed.

**Integration flow:**
1. Create Webhook config: `POST /api/hccgw/webhook/v1/config/save`
2. Subscribe to events: `POST /api/hccgw/rawmsg/v1/mq/subscribe` or `POST /api/hccgw/alarm/v1/mq/subscribe`
3. Receive event notifications via configured Webhook endpoint
4. Return HTTP 2XX for success, non-2XX for failure (5s timeout)

**Security - Callback URL Verification:**
When creating/updating Webhook, the platform sends an HTTPS GET to the callback URL with headers:
- `X-Hook-Batch-Id` - random string
- `X-Hook-Timestamp` - request timestamp

Response must include `X-Hook-Signature` header with valid signature.

**Security - Push Message Verification:**
Headers sent by platform to callback URL:
- `X-Hook-Batch-Id` - matches batchId in request body
- `X-Hook-Signature` - digital signature (format: `algorithm=signature`, e.g., `sha256=ede4cd...`)
- `X-Hook-Timestamp` - request timestamp (validate within 1 minute for freshness)

**Signature algorithm:**
```
message = timestamp + "." + batchId
signature = HMAC-SHA256(message, signSecret)
X-Hook-Signature = "sha256=" + hex(signature)
```

`signSecret` is specified during Webhook registration (defaults to SecretKey if omitted).

**Security requirement:** Callback URLs must use HTTPS.

## A.2 Time/Date Format

### A.2.1 ISO 8601 Time Format

A.2.1 ISO 8601 Time Format Instruction 
ISO 8601, Data Elements and Interchange Formats - Information Interchange - Representation of 
Dates and Times, is an international standard covering the exchange of date and time-related data 
format issued by ISO. An uppercase T should be added before an exact 
time to represent the 
combination of date and time. Beijing time 5:30:08 PM May 3rd, 2004 can be written as 
2004-05-03T17:30:08+08:00 or 20040503T173008+08.


### A.2.2 Date Format

| Format | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `yyyy/MM/dd` | yyyy, the year of 4 digits containing era. MM, the month of 2 digits. dd, the date of a month. E.g., 2024/01/31 |
| `yyyy-MM-dd` | E.g., 2024-01-31 |
| `yyyy.MM.dd` | E.g., 2024.01.31 |
| `dd/MM/yyyy` | E.g., 31/01/2024 |
| `dd-MM-yyyy` | E.g., 31-01-2024 |
| `MM-dd-yyyy` | E.g., 01-31-2024 |
| `yy-MM-dd` | yy, the year of 2 digits without era. E.g., 24-01-31 |
| `yy/MM/dd` | E.g., 24/01/31 |
| `dd/MM/yy` | E.g., 24.01.31 |
| `yy.MM.dd` | E.g., 24.01.31 |
| `yyyyddMM` | E.g., 20243101 |
| `yyyyMMdd` | E.g., 20240131 |
| `MMddyyyy` | E.g., 01312024 |
| `ddMMyyyy` | E.g., 31012024 |
| `yyddMM` | E.g., 243101 |
| `yyMMdd` | E.g., 240131 |
| `MMddyy` | E.g., 013124 |
| `ddMMyy` | E.g., 310124 |

### A.2.3 Time Format

| Format | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `HH:mm` | HH, the hour in 24-hour format. E.g., 13:30, 01:30 |
| `h:mm` | h, the hour in 12-hour format. No zero is added to hours of only one digit. E.g., 1:30 |
| `hh:mm tt` | hh, the hour in 12-hour format with AM/PM indicator. E.g., 01:30 AM |
| `h:mm tt` | E.g., 1:30 AM |
| `HH:mm:ss` | ss, the second. E.g., 01:30:05 |
| `h:mm:ss` | E.g., 1:30:05 |
| `hh:mm:ss tt` | E.g., 01:30:05 AM |
| `h:mm:ss tt` | E.g., 1:30:05 AM |
| `HHmm` | E.g., 1330 |
| `Hmm` | H, the hour in 24-hour format. No zero is added. E.g., 130 |
| `HHmmss` | E.g., 013005 |
| `hmmss` | E.g., 13005 |

### A.2.4 Time Duration Format

| Format | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `HH:MM` | Duration in hour and minute. E.g., 01:30 |
| `MM` | Duration in minute. E.g., 120 |

### AccessLevel

| timeInfo | No | AlarmTimeInfo | Alarm time. |
| eventSourceAlarm | No | EventSource | Alarm event source. |
| alarmRule | No | AlarmRule | Alarm rule. |
| alarmPriority | No | AlarmPriority | Alarm priority. |
| markState | No | String | Whether the alarm is tagged: "0" (untagged), "1" (tagged). |
| affirmedState | No | String | Whether the alarm is acknowledged: "0" (unacknowledged), "1" (acknowledged). |
| fileInfo | No | AlarmFileInfo | Alarm file details. |
| linkageType | No | String[] | Linkage type: "0"-recording linkage, "1"-GIS maplinkage, "2"-alarm output linkage, "3"-pop-up windowlinkage, "4"-door linkage. |
| linkageConfigAlarm | No | LinkageConfig | Linkage configuration. |
| vehicleRelatedInfo | No | VehicleRelatedInfo | Linked vehicle information. |
| queueRelatedInfo | No | QueueRelatedInfo | Queuing-alarm related information. |
| anprInfo | No | ANPRInfo | Vehicle blocklist/allowlist alarm event details. |

### EventSource

**Alarm Source Enumeration Values:**

| Enumeration Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `alarmInput` | Alarm Input |
| `camera` | Camera |
